item.title: National Cliches
Leadership Workshops
item.description: Leadership Workshops The leadership workshop of a large corporate organisation is in full swing. More than 30 participants are actively engaged in discussions. The topic at hand: there are a lot of projects and activities and an obvious lack of focus. “Shall we give $100 to everyone who closes a project?” someone proposes. Excitement rises in the room; there is a suggestion to raise the bar and introduce a bounty program to hunt down projects and kill them.

item.title: Matthew Walker, Why We Sleep
item.description: Just finished reading a book Why We Sleep by Matthew Walker. It highlights the importance of sleep and can largely be summarized in a sentence: Sleep more and you will improve the probability of success in all aspects of life. Most practical advice about the methods on improving sleep quality I found in Chapter 14: “The obvious methods involve reducing caffeine and alcohol intake, removing screen technology from the bedroom, and having a cool bedroom.

item.title: Friedrich Duerrenmatt's Plays and Books
item.description: Recently, I discovered a new author for myself: Friedrich Duerrenmatt. He was a Swiss author and dramatist in XX century. So far I red three of his books and quite enjoyed all of them: The Physicists. I recommend to read it in german, if possible. It is a satiric drama that reflects on the times of the Cold War. Apparently, this is one of the most played theater pieces in German speaking Switzerland, Germany and Austria.

item.title: Dog stats
item.description: Dog stats If you ever consider of getting a dog, this page might help you estimate how much to expect in the first year. We bought a dog in October 2023 and called her Yoki. Here is the picture of the beast: From the start we decided to scientifically approach the training process and track her activities. The question was where to track them? After searching for out-of-the-box solutions in the Web, Playstore and Android I decided to make my own Android app to track her pee and poo events.
